English perfect नहीं होगी, झूठ नहीं बोलूंगी। पर इतना होगा कि तुम बोल पाओगे। बिना रुके, बिना डरे, बिना शर्माए और वही काफी है शुरू करने के लिए। Experts सिखाएं, मेरे साथ practice करो। Trial सिर्फ ₹1। No बहाना, सिर्फ practice। English सीखो app आज ही download करो। [As-salamu alaykum. I am giving you a challenge. 14 days, 15 minutes daily, watch expert videos, practice with me. Before May ends, you will start speaking English. Do you have the courage of ₹1? Look, learning English is not difficult. Starting is difficult. So start today. Download the English Seekho app. Take the two-week challenge. Just 15 minutes daily. First week, watch experts' videos. It's a Spoken English show, they teach English by explaining in Hindi. It will start from the basics. Hello, thank you, excuse me, from here. Short two-to-five minute videos. So easy that you'll feel even you can do it. Second week, practice with me. I am your AI coach. Available 24 hours. Even at 5:00 AM, and at 12:00 midnight. Whatever you learned in the expert's video, practice speaking it with me. If you speak wrong, I will correct you. If pronunciation is wrong, I will catch it. If you used the wrong tense, I will tell you. Speak wrong 100 times, I will correct you 100 times. I will never laugh, never judge, never say you don't even know this much. And the biggest thing, you don't have to talk to any stranger. No need to feel embarrassed speaking wrong English in front of a stranger. Just you and me. Private, safe, at your speed. What will happen in 14 days? English won't be perfect, I won't lie. But it will be enough that you will be able to speak. Without stopping, without fear, without embarrassment, and that is enough to start. Experts teach, practice with me. Trial for just ₹1. No excuses, just practice. Download the English Seekho app today.]
Speaker B: Install Now पे क्लिक करो और अभी English Seekho ऐप डाउनलोड करो। [Click on Install Now and download the English Seekho app right now.]

summary: An AI avatar challenges viewers to a 14-day English-speaking challenge on the English Seekho app for just 1 rupee. She explains that users will watch expert videos in the first week and practice speaking with her as an AI coach in the second week. She promises non-judgmental, private corrections to help users speak confidently.
